headline: Bansal Wire Industries: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Bansal Wire Industries disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares under SEBI Regulation 31(4), triggering mandatory disclosure obligations under the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) Regulations, 2011.
detail: Bansal Wire Industries Limited submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE. This regulatory step is triggered when an acquirer crosses statutory shareholding thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, etc.), mandating within 4 working days publication of the acquirer's identity, the number of shares acquired, the percentage acquired, the consideration, and any concert party arrangements. The specific details of the acquirer, acquisition quantum and value are contained in the disclosure document filed with the exchange.
